show: I Said No Gifts! A comedy interview podcast with Bridger Winegar

faehigkeiten.grund: Dynamik weder belegt noch ausgeschlossen (Abruf laeuft ueber den Werbedienst podtrac.com) - zu wenig fuer ein Urteil, aber nicht nichts; Ausschnitte dieser Sendung waren in zwei Messungen mit Stunden Abstand stumm - die Datei wird je Abruf neu zusammengesetzt

einzeiler: Comedian Steph Tolev brings an unexpected and very noisy Halloween present.
kurzfassung: Comedian Steph Tolev joins the show to discuss fast-casual salads, unfortunate viral videos, and the high cost of renting Halloween props. The conversation touches on bizarre public encounters, past terrible day jobs, and a game testing gift etiquette. Tolev even surprises the host with an animated, flatulating skeleton sitting on a toilet.
stichpunkte: Discussion about the dryness of Sweetgreen salads and the need for heavy dressing
Steph Tolev shares a failed, highly unpopular video where she pretended to be a kale masseuse
An encounter on the street with the mystery man who lived inside a billboard for a promotional stunt
Sharing memories of terrible past day jobs, including catering and Airbnb cleaning
Steph Tolev presents the host with an animated skeleton sitting on a toilet that makes fart noises
Playing a game of celebrity invite lists for a party and rating listener dilemmas as gifts or curses
An advice segment addressing a listener who struggles with showing appreciation when receiving gifts

kapitel.titel: Salad debates and viral video regrets
Choking hazards and the billboard man
Worst jobs and terrible past employment
The animated spooky toilet skeleton gift
Party invite list and gift-or-curse games
Listener advice on ungrateful gift reactions

clips.text: The guest describes pouring significant effort into a comedic sketch about massaging leafy greens, only for it to completely bomb and fail to gain traction online.
The conversation shifts to past employment, with the guest admitting she fabricated her credentials to land a childcare gig despite having zero experience.

clips.hook: An absolute mood killer at a party
clips.text: Two comedians recall dressing up in obscure, highly elaborate television character costumes that completely confused everyone and left them standing alone in the backyard.
In a sarcastic escalation, the guest claims her front lawn features a massive, immovable structure bolted permanently into the concrete with government permits.

clips.hook: Getting ripped off for a wheelchair rental
clips.text: The guest complains about being overcharged hundreds of dollars by a specialty shop after keeping a prop medical device an extra day.

beschreibung:
Bridger chooses not to retaliate even after Steph Tolev arrives with a gift. The two discuss choking hazards, salad moisture levels, and holiday decor.

Don't forget to review the podcast, it's the least you can do.
